purpose: Independent-seed null calibration confirmation of the subject-level within-subject pair reducer for the production S0 Mphase route. The same per-pair corrected Mphase values are reduced by both median and arithmetic mean, then compared within matched worlds. This stage contains no power or positive-effect arm.

independence.rule: Every formal world seed must be in the frozen range and outside every excluded range. No discovery checkpoint or result is an input.

production_mphase.filter: third-order zero-phase Butterworth within each continuous clean block

subject_reducers.median: median of all finite per-pair corrected Mphase values within subject and run
subject_reducers.mean: arithmetic mean of the identical finite per-pair corrected Mphase values within subject and run
subject_reducers.matched_rule: Both reducers use the same pair rows and the same finite-value mask. Reducer choice must not alter synthesis, events, surrogates, or subject inclusion.

pair_level: bias-corrected skewness of per-subject pair values
world_level: null center across worlds as mean(observed)/sample_SD(observed)

paired_difference.definition: Delta = FPR_mean - FPR_median within matched world and run

rules.pass: For R1 and R2 separately, the mean-reducer FPR Clopper-Pearson interval contains 0.05.
For R1 and R2 separately, the 95% Newcombe interval for FPR_mean - FPR_median has upper bound < 0.
For R1 and R2 separately, the median-reducer FPR Clopper-Pearson lower bound is > 0.05.
For R1 and R2 separately: mean p is in [0.40,0.60], the Clopper-Pearson interval for Pr(p < 0.5) contains 0.5, and the Clopper-Pearson interval for Pr(p > 0.75) contains 0.25.

classification.CONFIRMED: All four rules pass in both runs with exactly 120 matched worlds.
classification.NOT_CONFIRMED: The run is complete but one or more frozen rules fail.
classification.INCOMPLETE: Any checkpoint, identity, subject count, export, or matched-world requirement is missing or invalid.

preregistered_decision.failure_policy: Do not change reducer, thresholds, bins, seed count, seed range, schedule, or configuration after seeing Stage A results. Report the failed rule and stop before designing any power arm.

engineering.checkpoint: v7.3 MAT, one world per file, save to .tmp.mat then atomic move to final path

validator.bridge: MATLAB loads v7.3 table/string fields and writes flat TSV only; it performs no statistical reduction.
independent_checks: exact two-sided sign-flip p values from subject rows
matched rejection table and Newcombe method 10 interval
validator.v7_3_constraint: Python must not read MATLAB table/string objects directly with h5py.
